label: Statutory pay of the Taoiseach, rates effective from 1 June 2026
amount: €256,311 a year (TD basic salary €119,467 + Taoiseach's salaried allowance €136,844)
detail: Published rates for the office, not a personal declaration. The Houses of the Oireachtas note that members and office holders 'may have chosen to waive receipt of some salary or allowances' and that the ministerial allowance is paid by the department concerned (for the Taoiseach, the Department of the Taoiseach). Ireland has no public declaration of total assets or net worth for TDs or ministers; the Register of Members' Interests covers specified interests only (see interests).
